description: This file defines the StreamSubscriptionManager class, which manages stream subscriptions within the Orleans streaming framework. It provides methods to add, remove, and retrieve subscriptions, interacting with an external pub/sub system.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionManager
classes.description: Manages stream subscriptions, allowing addition, removal, and retrieval of subscriptions for a specific stream provider and stream ID.

methods.name: AddSubscription
methods.description: Creates and registers a new subscription for a given stream provider, stream ID, and grain reference.

methods.name: RemoveSubscription
methods.description: Unregisters a subscription based on stream provider, stream ID, and subscription ID.

methods.name: GetSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a specific stream provider and stream ID.
